# AI Learning and Knowledge Platform

Build a learning platform that helps learners explore topics, search trusted resources, practice concepts, and assess understanding.

## Required behavior
- [ ] Structured course catalog and searchable learning content
- [ ] Document-grounded assistant with source links
- [ ] Quizzes with answer validation and explanations
- [ ] User-controlled progress and preferences
- [ ] Evaluation set for relevance, factual support, and retrieval
- [ ] Authentication, access control, data minimization, and secure configuration
- [ ] Monitoring for latency, costs, failures, and quality regressions
- [ ] Technical report with intended use, limitations, results, and safety choices

Use synthetic or properly licensed data. Do not commit credentials or personal data. Document setup, evaluation, limitations, and reset instructions.

"""Starter scaffold for AI Learning and Knowledge Platform.

Implement one milestone at a time and keep evaluation separate from development.
"""

def main():
    print("Project: AI Learning and Knowledge Platform")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
